taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA RN2 | Renal Pathology II: Tubulointerstitial, Vascular & Neoplastic.

words.clue: Heterogeneous group of renal disorders primarily injuring tubules and interstitium rather than glomeruli
Acronym for the most important cause of intrinsic acute kidney injury
Form of acute tubular necrosis resulting from shock or severe hypoperfusion
Form of acute tubular necrosis caused by direct toxic injury like aminoglycosides or contrast media
Granular muddy-brown structures composed of necrotic debris that obstruct tubular lumens
Cell layer that undergoes necrosis and sloughing in acute tubular necrosis
Programmed cell death mechanism triggered by ATP depletion in ischaemic injury
Mechanism allowing filtered glomerular fluid to leak back through denuded basement membrane
Protein released in rhabdomyolysis that precipitates as brown casts at acidic pH
Acute or chronic infectious tubulointerstitial disease with neutrophilic infiltrate and white cell casts
Persistent afferent arteriolar narrowing due to prostaglandin and endothelin imbalance in acute tubular necrosis
